links.outcome: Differences in sentiment, subjectivity, reading ease, word frequency and entity count of LLM discharge instructions across race/ethnicity
links.effect: Only significant difference was entity count for GPT-4 (df=42, P=.047); post hoc pairwise tests after Bonferroni correction showed no significant differences. Four LLMs were relatively invariant to race/ethnicity.
links.quote: The only observed statistically significant difference between race/ethnicity groups was found in entity count (GPT-4, df=42, P=.047).

screen.reason: Empirical study testing for racial and ethnic bias/disparities in discharge instructions generated by four commercial LLMs using simulated prompt variations, but it does not evaluate an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
